title: Amt Züssow takes website offline after attempted hacker attack, Nordkurier reports
date_note: The page gives only its publication day, 25 November 2026; it does not say when the attempted attack happened.
geo_basis: Amt Züssow, the administration named by the source; coordinates for Züssow
summary: Nordkurier reports that the website of Amt Züssow is unreachable after an attempted hacker attack; the Amt took its servers off the internet as a precaution. Amtsvorsteher Holger Wendt says staff can still work internally, residents should phone, and the site will stay offline until the Amt can confirm all vulnerabilities are fixed. The page does not say whether any data was accessed.
plain: The Züssow administration's website is offline after an attempted hacker attack; the Amtsvorsteher says it stays down until vulnerabilities are fixed. The report does not say whether data was accessed.
exec: A German local administration took its website offline after an attempted attack; the report gives no end date.
action: As Amtsvorsteher Holger Wendt says, residents with requests should phone the Amt (numbers are in the Amtsblatt); online appointment booking still works.

validation.note: Only Nordkurier, quoting Amtsvorsteher Holger Wendt, was read; no statement from the Amt's own site or an authority.

review.note: title, date note, Wendt statements, no-data statement, phone/booking advice checked against Nordkurier
